clips.shows: Close-up of a man wrapping white hand wraps around his hands and wrists before boxing. Black sleeveless top, torso and arms only, static camera. Background is a dim red-walled boxing gym: a hanging steel chain at left, a black heavy bag at right, out-of-focus white labels low on the left wall. Warm, moody, low light; colour (deep red and black), desaturates well.
clips.faces_visible: no (head out of frame for all 19 seconds)
clips.logo_check: Pass. 19 frames (1 per second) checked on the contact sheet, then full-resolution frames and 2x crops of the background corners. Garment plain. The heavy bag carries no visible print. The white labels on the back wall at lower left are out of focus in every frame and no character is legible; a small white blob under the bag at right is unreadable. No brand mark found.
clips.use_note: decorative, aria-hidden, never captioned as BeBetter's customers or gyms. Stock models, not BeBetter athletes or members; the handover asks for BeBetter's own footage to replace it. Muted, plays only in view, paused under prefers-reduced-motion, poster frame first. Convert to WebM for QA playback (the container Chromium has no H.264). If used full bleed, crop or mask the left 15% to keep the blurred wall labels out entirely.
